description: Returns the next retrograde of Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto after a date (or the one in progress, until it stations direct), with sign, shadows, cazimi or opposition, and stations. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope.

from.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.

name: next_planet_retrograde
title: Next retrograde of a planet
